scenarios.statement: A patient who arrives at the emergency ward is seen by a triage nurse within ten minutes.
Triage is staffed by two nurses on a rota that is posted in the ward each Friday.
Until the new bridge opens, the ferry keeps running on its present timetable.
The bridge carries two lanes of traffic in each direction, and it will be opened in stages, one direction first.
The kitchen serves only the dishes that travel well in the delivery van.
The search runs on three servers behind one address.
Move the search from the old servers to the new ones before March.
Voters can cast a ballot at any polling place in their county, and the polling places will move to schools this year.
The museum leads each visitor through the collection in date order, and a printed map handed out at the door shows the way.
